L14n92.name: Mid-phrase function word
L14n92.description: Weak, diffuse firing on mid-phrase words in web prose, peaking on a pronoun or particle that ends a verb phrase (e.g. 'it' in 'food in it's most natural form', 'us' in 'care for us', 'just' in 'skip just this instance', 'up' in 'looked up'). Steered, it pushes word fragments like 'threshold', 'electro' and 'apore'; the logit lens points at closing quote-and-punctuation.

L14n2251.name: Product-topic adjective before noun
L14n2251.description: Strongly negative on the topic adjective in a writing request, right before its noun: 'smart' in 'smart home hubs', 'renewable' in 'renewable energy', 'classic' in 'classic chicken noodle soup', 'new' in 'new software program', 'wireless' in 'wireless touch screen'. Mostly silent elsewhere. Steered negative pushes word fragments ('ancial', 'oretical', 'ionale') rather than a clear word.

L14n1811.name: Answer-topic head noun
L14n1811.description: Strongly negative on the noun or heading word that a reply is about, right where the answer starts: 'song' in 'which specific song', 'film' in 'which film', 'Best' in 'Oscar for Best Actor', 'Subject' opening a drafted email, 'graphic' in 'eye-catching image or graphic', 'Chart' in 'using Chart.js'. Steered, it pushes fragments like 'apore' and 'reshold'.

L0n9.name: Closing </think> tag
L0n9.description: Fires on the '</think>' token that closes the empty think block at the start of a chat assistant reply (peak 10; the opening '<think>' about 5). Weak on other closing delimiters. Steered, it pushes closing brackets: full-width '）' and '）。' and ')'.

L24n2097.name: Digit before percent sign
L24n2097.description: Strongly negative on the last digit of a number followed by a percent sign or the word 'percent': the '0' in '100%', the '0' in '50 percent', the '9' in '59%'. The '%' right after gets a smaller hit. Steered negative pushes the model to write '%' (steered output is all '%').

L14n2233.name: Opening parenthesis of aside
L14n2233.description: Strongly negative on the '(' or comma that opens an explanatory aside, gloss, or citation: '(' in 'arribadas (arrival of nesting sea turtles)', '(temperature, pulse, respirations)', '(also commonly referred to as VFDs)', and the comma in 'Flickr, CC BY'. Also on 'means' or 'change' right before a definition. Steered, it gives noise such as 'errors' and 'gibi'.

L24n248.name: Capital letter for names
L24n248.description: Fires on the capital letter that starts a proper name or surname, most often a lone initial or the first piece of a name split into tokens: 'N' in 'N. Atzagioli', 'M' in 'Macclesfield', 'S' in 'Saphari', 'T' in 'Haft-T-alar'. Peaks on the letter itself, not the rest of the name. Steering does not produce names; it gives garbled fragments.

L11n9.name: Name-ending piece before citation
L11n9.description: Strongly negative on the last piece of a name or word just before a citation, parenthesis or comma: 'man' in 'Schiffman et al.', 'oks' in 'Estabrooks', 'ik' in 'Høivik', 'en' in 'Nordhausen', 'I' in 'RGGI states'. Also on the '(' in 'infrastructure (dwellings' and a few clause-final words ('well', 'above', 'those'). Steered, it gives asterisks.

L14n3017.name: Content word before complement
L14n3017.description: Diffusely negative on the content word that opens a purpose or complement phrase in instructions and descriptions: 'explore' in 'to explore', 'water' in 'provide water', 'health' in 'skin health', 'official' in 'official pip website', 'package' in 'pip3 install <package>', 'diverse' in 'its diverse'. Steered, it gives word fragments ('ellij', 'loit', 'ionale'), not a word.

L12n623.name: Mid-phrase word, keyword list
L12n623.description: Diffuse, weak positive on a word in the middle of a phrase where the text keeps going, e.g. 'is' in 'the body is part way out', 'to' in 'hash to', 'his' in 'until his death', 'tools' in 'study tools', and the keyword strings of essay-spam lists. Steered, it pushes em dashes and ellipses ('—', '…') and the steered output is asterisks.

L24n1478.name: 'mis-' word prefix
L24n1478.description: Fires on the 'mis' piece that opens words like 'misperceptions', 'mischance', 'misinformed', 'mischievous', 'misfortune', 'misfits', with the next piece ('per' in 'mis|per|ceptions') sometimes peaking. Weak on 'eye' and on 'to' after 'ability'. Steered, it pushes 'recognition' and 'recognize' (steered output is 'recognition' repeated).

L24n2382.name: Problem and conflict words
L24n2382.description: Fires on words for a problem or conflict that head a phrase: mostly 'problem' in 'problem-solving' or 'problem solving', and 'conflict' in 'conflict management', plus 'puzzles', 'mystery', 'complaints', 'scenarios', 'suspense'. Steered, it pushes 'resolution' and 'resolve' (steered output is 'resolution' repeated).

L14n2258.name: Predicate word in examples
L14n2258.description: Diffuse, positive on the word right after a subject or quiz cue in example sentences and exercise items: 's' in 'Jessica's failure', 'must' in 'A robot must respond', 'was' in 'which was recorded', 'you' in 'as you requested', 'to do' in exercise prompts. Top tokens include 'quiz', 'Question' and 'Jessica'. Steered, it pushes 'arbonate' and 'uali' fragments.

L22n492.name: Table field label
L22n492.description: Strongly negative on the label word that heads a field or column in a pipe-delimited table, just before the '||' or '|' separator: 'Rank' in '|Rank||', 'Address', 'Owner', 'Presenter', 'Location', 'View', 'Atomic Weight', 'Type'. Weaker on the ';' and '.' that end a code line or sentence. Steered, it writes blank spaces, nothing decodable.

L24n2416.name: 'Job' and hiring words
L24n2416.description: Strongly negative on 'job' and related hiring words, mostly 'job' before a noun such as application, description, posting, interview or market ('a job application'), with weaker hits on 'intern', 'admissions', 'licensing' and 'graduate'. Steered, it pushes 'candidate' or 'applicant' (steered output: 'candidates candidates...').

L24n114.name: Letter inside parentheses
L24n114.description: Fires on the content token inside a parenthesis, especially a single unit letter or abbreviation: 'K' in '(K)' kelvin, 'm' in '(m)' meter, 'd' in '(d)', 's' and 't' in '(s)' and '(t)', 'ce' in 'b ce', plus unit tokens like 'months' and 'oz'. Peaks on the token just before the closing ')'. Steered, it pushes ')' followed by a quote or period (steered output: ')."').

L24n2887.name: URL or path fragment
L24n2887.description: Fires on a piece inside a URL, filename or code path: 'ip' in 'get-pip.py', 'aspx' and 'html' in web addresses, 'fund' in 'superfund', 'tips' in a us-cert URL, 'whats-new' in an MLA link, 'Share' in 'Share-Alike', 'afety' in 'cyber-safety', and ']' in '[root@chris ~]#'. Steered, it pushes '#' (steered output is a run of '#'). Read and write do not match well.

L24n2406.name: Zero before hex 'x'
L24n2406.description: Strongly negative on the '0' of a hex literal before 'x' ('P0 = 0xA4': the '0' peaks at 10, other digits in hex lines 8 to 9), with weaker hits on name syllables like 'Hum' in 'humane' and 'Rad' in 'Radley'. Steered, it pushes 'x' (logit lens: 'x', 'xc', 'xC'); steered output is a repeated 'x'.

L0n1967.name: Mid-word subword piece
L0n1967.description: Strongly negative on a subword piece in the middle or end of a long word split across tokens: 'actors' in 'tr|actors' (Ferguson tractors), 'ite' in 'Amor|ite', 'oli' in 'Atzagi|oli', 'oth' in 'To|oth', 'rail' in 'rail|roads', 'ons' in 'axons'. Steered, it pushes person names ('Charles', 'Born', 'Leaders'), but that write is weak.

L20n1662.name: German word fragments
L20n1662.description: Strongly negative on a middle or final piece of a German (or other non-English) word split into tokens: 'itung' in 'Zeitung', 'und' in 'Inbund', 'st' in 'Ostermarkt', 'tt' in 'Brunsbüttel', 'zug' in 'Sommertagszug', 'rik' in 'Hendrik', 'in' in 'Schwerin'. Mostly silent on English. Steered, it gives 's' tokens ('sssss'), so the write is weak.
